mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y-o-y, signaling a potential supply chain disruption or weakening manufacturing sector, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO y-o-y growth < -2% but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales are rising simultaneously, indicating a strong consumer demand environment, S&P 500 returns are likely to be positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS rising y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and rising, indicating a tightening monetary policy, S&P 500 returns are likely to be negative over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by an inverted yield curve.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% y-o-y, signaling a weakening labor market, and the unemployment rate is simultaneously rising, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS y-o-y growth < -1% and UNRATE rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is accelerating and consumer price inflation is rising, indicating strong demand-side pressures, S&P 500 returns are likely to be positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL both accelerating but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth is slowing and the federal funds rate is rising, indicating a potential supply shock combined with tightening financial conditions, S&P 500 returns are likely to be negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth slowing and FEDFUNDS rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.
